name: task-track
description: Keeps the active Obsidian task note in view (band, pane), runs one shared Pomodoro you can /pomo start, pause, resume and stop, and lets /note, /done, /openloop write to the note without a model turn.

vaultPath.title: Vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault, used when vaults.json ($ADHD_PLANNER_VAULTS, else ~/.config/adhd-planner/vaults.json) is absent, unreadable or invalid. Empty: $VAULT, else ~/vault.

focusMinutes.title: Focus block (minutes)
focusMinutes.description: Active minutes per Pomodoro block before a break nudge.

breakMinutes.title: Short break (minutes)
breakMinutes.description: Suggested break length. Idle this long counts as a break taken and resets the block.

longBreakEvery.title: Long break every N blocks
longBreakEvery.description: Every Nth completed block asks for the long break instead.

staleEdits.title: Stale-log nudge after N edits
staleEdits.description: File edits by Claude since the task Log last changed before nudging. 0 turns it off.

notesToClaude.title: Tell Claude about /note, /done, /openloop
notesToClaude.description: Adds a hidden one-line note to the conversation so Claude knows what you logged.

breakSummaryAI.title: AI line in the break notification
breakSummaryAI.description: Off by default. While on, each block records your prompts (first 80 characters), files Claude edits and commands it runs in vault/Tasks/.pomo.json, a file in your synced vault, and asks Claude Haiku for one line on what got done (about $0.0005 a break).
